limitations: Moving static remains unacceptable to the user; no renderer/grain/default changes in this audit.
Earlier tiny-step and perceptual measurements remain historical and were not rerun as new motion research.
External Firefox, captured mouse, physical hardware failure, driver image processing, and a hardware floor were not newly verified.
Actual BFCache hit not confirmed; ordinary browser-Back restoration verified.
Viewport narrower than spacing not exercised by the embedded host.
